name: ocr_assist
description: Read text from the current image via _call_ocr_assist(); prefer image_obj= when chaining from a crop.
usage_notes: Default OCR hyperparameters are set by runtime; usually call _call_ocr_assist() without extra kwargs.

name: manual_box
description: Draw a box from explicit pixel coords via _call_manual_box(x1,y1,x2,y2,...).
usage_notes: Use when coordinates are known; cheaper than detection-based grounding.

name: manual_crop
description: Crop a rectangle via _call_manual_crop(x1,y1,x2,y2,...); often followed by ocr_assist on the crop.
usage_notes: Prefer over dino_crop when the region is known.

name: ground_box
description: Localize a target from a text prompt via _call_ground_box(text_prompt,...); returns a boxed image.
usage_notes: Good first step when location is unknown.

name: sam_mask
usage_notes: Use when a mask visualization helps more than a tight box.

name: dino_crop
description: Crop likely regions from grounding via _call_dino_crop(text_prompt,...); prefer box-based crop.
usage_notes: Chain image_obj=box['image'] after ground_box when needed.

name: blur_bg
description: Blur background while keeping subject clear via _call_blur_bg(text_prompt,...).
